units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:38">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ההן דִּגְבַל כ׳</he> (or <he>דְּגַבַּל</he>) he who kneads lime dust.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:13">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ונִיגְבּוֹל בדובשא</he> let him knead it with honey.

<cite ref="Gittin 69a">Ib.</cite> <he>וניגדול … וניגבול בהדין קיטמא</he> Ar. (Var. v. <cite ref="C01238"><he>גַּרְבֵּל</he></cite>; ed. <he>וניגדבל</he>) let him twist … and mix (the wick) thoroughly with ashes.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite>, end <he>גַּבְלִין ליה וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00421"><he>אֲדַמְדְּמָנֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 67b:10">Ḥull. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>מיניה קא גַבְלֵי</he> they grow out of it (originate in the body).
<cite ref="Chullin 67b:10">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>כי קא גַבְלָן וכ׳</he> when they grew, they grew as permitted food.

senses.gloss: as Pe. 1).—Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᵈ top <he>ומְגַבְּלָא אדמיה וכ׳</he> and to mix its blood with flax-seed.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 69a:6">B. Mets. 69ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>גַּבֵּיל לתורא גביל לתורי</he> mix (fodder) for an ox, mix for oxen, i.e. it is the same trouble.
<cite ref="Berakhot 40a:1">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>גביל לתורי</he> (if he interrupted himself by saying,) ‘Mix fodder for the oxen’.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> <he>אִיגַּבְּלוּן בלישה</he> the coins were kneaded with the dough.
